FN-XDB1W77-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 46
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/16/2026
Senate Bill 46 as introduced could increase the obligations of Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an undetermined amount to provide for the voluntarily designation of
certain medical conditions on an individual's driver license or identification card.
